items.title: Type-tighten PluginSettings.backend to union literal
items.acceptance: backend field typed as 'api' | 'claude-code' | 'codex'; npm run typecheck passes
items.notes: Currently typed as string; only three values are valid; union catches typos at compile time

items.title: Fix copyToClipboard to use i18n copyFailed key
items.acceptance: copyToClipboard catch block uses translate(null, 'copyFailed', {error}) instead of hardcoded English
items.validation: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
items.notes: Line 56: 'Copy failed: ...' bypasses i18n; translate() can be called with null settings to get user-language string

items.title: Fix addIconButton/addTextButton catch blocks to use i18n actionFailed key
items.acceptance: Both catch blocks use translate(null, 'actionFailed', {label, error}) instead of hardcoded template strings
items.validation: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
items.notes: Lines 21 and 45: '${title} failed: ...' hardcoded English; i18n key 'actionFailed' already exists in both languages

items.title: Add parseCardsJson edge-case tests (cards key missing or null)
items.acceptance: Tests added for: valid JSON with no cards key returns [], cards:null returns [], cards:{} (object) returns []
items.notes: normalizeCardsPayload edge cases with null/missing/wrong-type cards already exist; parseCardsJson path through normalizeCardsPayload not covered for these cases

items.title: Fix normalizeCardsPayload fallback title from hardcoded Chinese to translate()
items.acceptance: Fallback title uses translate(null, 'noTitle') with new i18n key added to both languages; test updated
items.validation: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
items.notes: Line 143: '(无标题)' is hardcoded Chinese; should resolve to language-appropriate '(Untitled)' or '(无标题)' via translate()

items.title: Fix a11y: associate labels to inputs in CardEditModal
items.acceptance: Each label element has matching for attribute; each input/textarea has matching id; screen readers can navigate correctly
items.validation: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
items.notes: createLabeledInput and createLabeledTextarea create <label> but no id/for linkage; fails WCAG 1.3.1

items.title: Fix hardcoded 'Cancel'/'OK' in confirmRegenerateEditedCards
items.acceptance: Button text strings come from parameters; caller in main.ts passes plugin.t('editCardCancel') and plugin.t('editCardSave')
items.validation: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
items.notes: Lines 19,23: hardcoded 'Cancel' and 'OK' bypass i18n; function accepts app+title+message but not translated button labels

items.title: Add missing CLI timeout setting to settings tab UI
items.acceptance: renderCliBackendSettings shows a numeric text input for cliTimeoutMs; i18n keys settingCliTimeoutName already exist; saves on change
items.validation: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
items.notes: cliTimeoutMs exists in DEFAULT_SETTINGS and types; i18n key settingCliTimeoutName defined in both languages; but renderCliBackendSettings never renders it

items.title: Add missing description for Max output tokens setting
items.acceptance: settingMaxTokensDesc i18n key added to both languages; .setDesc() call added to the max tokens Setting
items.validation: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
items.notes: Line 218 in settings-tab.ts: .setName() but no .setDesc(); settingMaxTokensName key exists but no desc key

items.title: Fix hardcoded 'chars' counter text in streaming preview to use i18n
items.acceptance: Streaming counter uses plugin.t('streamChars', {count}) key; key added to both language tables
items.validation: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
items.notes: Lines 107,125 in view.ts: `${text.length} chars` hardcoded English; appears in streaming preview pane visible to all users

items.title: Guard exportToVault when sections list is empty
items.acceptance: exportToVault returns early with Notice('noExportContent') when this.sections.length === 0; no empty file created
items.validation: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
items.notes: Currently creates/overwrites a file with only frontmatter and empty body when sections=[]; noExportContent i18n key already exists

items.title: Add Alt+E keyboard shortcut to open edit modal for active card
items.acceptance: handleKeydown handles Alt+E; calls openEditCardModal(this.activeIdx) when activeIdx >= 0; does nothing when no active card
items.validation: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
items.notes: Alt+ArrowUp/Down already implemented; Edit is context-menu only; adding Alt+E enables keyboard-driven editing

items.title: Fix promptForBatchFolder hardcoded 'OK' button to use i18n
items.acceptance: promptForBatchFolder accepts okLabel parameter; caller in main.ts passes plugin.t('editCardSave') or a dedicated ok key
items.validation: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
items.notes: Line 121: hardcoded 'OK' button; similar to modal.ts confirmRegenerateEditedCards issue; should reuse existing i18n keys

items.title: Add Alt+Delete keyboard shortcut to delete active card
items.acceptance: handleKeydown handles Alt+Delete; calls deleteCard(this.activeIdx) when activeIdx >= 0; does nothing otherwise
items.validation: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
items.notes: Companion to FEAT-02; allows full keyboard card management (navigate, edit, delete) without mouse

items.title: Change default promptLanguage from 'zh' to 'auto'
items.acceptance: DEFAULT_SETTINGS.promptLanguage is 'auto'; normalizeSettings maps 'auto' to system language for the prompt; test updated
items.validation: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
items.notes: New users get Chinese output by default even with English UI (uiLanguage defaults to auto); 'auto' matches uiLanguage behavior
